title: Capture of exclusive fullscreen games
hypothesis: Desktop duplication (ddx) gets no new frames from the virtual display while a game is in exclusive fullscreen, so the stream stays black. Windows.Graphics.Capture (wgc), with Sunshine running in the user's session, captures it.

results.notes: ddx: black; Sunshine verbose log shows no new frames (re-sends the last one at the 30 fps minimum) and capture re-inits every ~1 s; visible only when the game loses focus
wgc with Sunshine in session 1 (task at logon, conhost --headless, service manual): game visible

conclusion: Adopted as a per-VM option, off by default (Options > Captura). wgc shows programs in exclusive fullscreen but not Windows' administrator prompts (secure desktop); ddx shows the prompts but exclusive fullscreen is black on a virtual display. No security change: in wgc Sunshine runs as the signed-in user (elevated) instead of SYSTEM; started by a logon task through conhost --headless so no console window appears.
